full_judgment: 18. It is a well established principle of law that a right or privilege once vested, cannot be taken back. Clearly the right to remain shielded from prosecution again for the same acts, was a valid right at the time it accrued to the petitioner by virtue of the presumption of validity. So even though the Ordinance ceased to exist as from the date this Division declared it ultra vires, yet rights that stemmed from it the during the period of its validity, cannot be erased.
